title: Incremental Lean progress toward P = NP
claims: The submitted Lean development is evaluated against the pinned brilliant-hq/pequalnp-proofs definitions and checker discipline.
The score is the highest proof_ladder_points rung whose Lean evidence checks without sorry, admit, native_decide, or axioms outside propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.
The final 100-point target is theorem PEqualNP.Outside.P_eq_NP with statement PEqualNP.Library.P = PEqualNP.Library.NP.

experiments.purpose: Inspect the submitted Lean project for named P/NP ladder targets and run the pequalnp final-target checker when possible.
